content:
MFA Madness!. Every time I or my wife go to open the app we have to [MARCA] 4 times. Needless to say this breaks spending alerts, and makes using the service a PITA! 
We didn’t have this issue with [MARCA]

Annoying to use. The app sets an automatic “spending plan” with limited options for customization. For me, this is not useful at all. I just want to be able to set my own monthly budget and then categorize spending from my credit card and checking accounts.
Buggy / Inaccurate. Always buggy, issues with app and clunky UI… I miss MINT 🥲
Worst budgeting app ever. Would not load all of my accounts. Very hard to work with. Wanted to love the app but there’s just too much wrong.
Bad with nfcu. Consistently fails to connect to ncfu. Even following all instructions listed online to troubleshoot nothing works. Probably won’t renew my subscription after this year.

Can’t Even View the App Without Paying. I thought I’d at least be able to view the app, maybe see the interface at least, before being pressured to buy. The only info I have about what this app offers is in the description on the [MARCA], you cannot advance past sign up without subscribing to the tune of almost $50 a year. I wouldn’t buy *anything* I had never seen or used before for $50 but I guess [APP] DOES assume everyone downloading this app isn’t great at managing money. There isn’t even a trial. It’s just “pay us $50, may hate it but that’s our first lesson in financial risk”. Too many options on the [MARCA] for that.

Trash, definitely not worth. Just like their Mac app, they don’t provide access to the necessary account systems that you need.  Secondly every single budget application seems to not care about your billing. They don’t even help you. They just waste your money. Don’t buy this app. Waste of money can’t help me organize my bills for nothing. How was it that you can’t login to various billing sites or even assist me with organizing the bills?  Again, do not buy this app not worth it.

Not a good substitute for [MARCA]. Switched to [APP] from mint, and I hate this app. Not intuitive, never categorizes correctly and changes the names of transactions to the most random things so it’s hard to recategorize. Wish I didn’t pay for it and can’t wait to switch to another app when it expires.
2x the price. Paid 35$ last yeas. Renewal is 71$.
$$$. I don’t feel like the cost is outrageous if it’s a good app. The problem is that there’s no way to know if the app works for you without paying for a year subscription first.

Totally broken as of a couple weeks ago. Used to work great. Now [MARCA] balance is totally out of sync. I have removed and reset the connection, followed the support team, troubleshooting, suggestions, and deleted and reinstalled the app. It works for a short period of time after reset then goes tout a sync again. This app was great but is now useless.

Bugs galore. - keeps telling me I need to reconnect to my [MARCA] account 
- sometimes when you click on a planned expense category it will say you’ve spent “$NaN.undefined” for this month. Sloppy - still need to reconnect via [MARCA] to my [MARCA] every time

App doesn’t work - worst service ever!!. The app doesn’t work and isn’t loading transactions for the last 5 days. Customer service was the worst and offered no help other than to upload screenshots of all my bank account, balances and transactions. I offered the transactions as proof of missing transactions but they wouldn’t look into the issue or cared at all unless having the bank account and balances. So shady and scam sounding. I’m not giving that info to a random person. They wouldn’t look into the issue or do anything to troubleshoot the issue. Even knowing there is clearly an issue with their app. No one should be giving out bank account info and balances for you to check into your connections with the bank institution and fix your app connections. It’s broken and not working rendering app useless and you have ridiculous people on the chat ([NOME]) asking for bank accounts and balances and doing nothing to move the ticket forward. They should be fired!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Apple Card. I was able to add my Apple Card sometime ago but now it doesn’t show up in my accounts. What happened?
Bad. Won’t let you try the app without paying for a year upfront won’t even let you in to see anything without paying

Don’t waste your money. If I could give it zero stars I would. Not sure where it gets the info from because I can have a thousand dollars in my account and it will tell me by balance is negative with no transactions outstanding. I have had to disconnect and reconnect to my bank accounts at least once a month since I purchased.  There are free apps out there that you can use that are less frustrating or time consuming. I had used [APP] for years on my desktop so when that finally died I was happy to move to the online version. Total trash!
Seriously?. No way to see the app. No limited trial - just a big subscription window. No thanks.

Another buggy mess. Bought a year subscription, because this app is supposed to be awesome. Right off the bat, only my checking accounts will link. All of my credit and auto accounts just give unspecified errors. I decided to skip those and push forward to set up the app, and now I’ve been stuck on “Working our magic!” for about an hour. A few API calls and an algorithm that analyzes transactions shouldn’t take more than a few seconds in a worst case scenario. Also received an automated email from the team lead with first steps, but it is formatted with white text on a white background, so I had to copy and paste it into the notes app to even read it. At this point, if it ever finishes “working magic”, I fully expect nothing to function. Take my advice, never buy promoted software that doesn’t have a free trial. Update: Finally got into the app, and it can’t even figure out that transactions with the exact same name and amount are recurring, so it keeps asking to add identical recurring transactions while saying I’m missing payments on the exact transaction. Absolutely DO NOT purchase this software. It does not work, and is absolutely a scam. At MOST, all this software is capable of doing is showing you your transactions. Everything else is 100% incorrect. Odds are high that your banking app can already show you transactions, making this app functionally pointless and useless. Account linking is broken for 99% of the things I’ve tried, so it isn’t even great at aggregating transactions across accounts. As a software engineer myself, I find it absolutely disgusting that a company would try to sell this and rip off millions of people looking for a solution to managing their finances. This company should be sued for fraud.

Update: This app no longer even displays something as simple as my balance correctly. They take my balance and remove the pending transactions, but my bank already does that. So it shows my balance with 2x the pending transactions removed. This application literally gets worse by the day.

Update: Still no fix to the double pending transaction removal. It appears as though development has been abandoned.
[MARCA]. Won’t sync with [MARCA], so the app is completely useless to me, and I’m unable to get a refund.

It’s wrong and confusing to use. Many times I find it has the wrong balances. It appears negative when my bank says otherwise or it says I have double the money that I have. Some financial institutions don’t sync and it keeps trying and failing. The [MARCA] is overly complicated for a budget app. It’s trying to do things it doesn’t need to do. Yet failing at things it should do like categorize expenses. I moved from mint and will be moving on from this because it’s not a good alternative. Overall not worth paying a subscription for.

Not good. Transactions get duplicated and now I’m missing transactions. Not good for tax time. [MARCA] was far better.  This is the second app I’ve tried and the other [APP] was missing transactions too. I don’t know what to do now.
This year double price!. No Thank You for doubling subscription price.  Greedy.

Unusable, unreliable.. The app has a bevy of known issues that never seem to get solved. My bank account balance is never accurate, cause forecasts to be wildly unpredictable and inaccurate. They keep saying they’re working on the issues but months later I still can’t rely on the tool. It’s now half of what I paid as they try to replace droves of fleeing users. Don’t bother.
Accounts won’t sync. Like the app so far. One problem I have with it is half of my accounts won’t sync with the app. This is frustrating when you have to pay for this app.

Worked well until it didn’t. One of the most important features is transaction import from your bank(s). Seeing this up ran smoothly for the most part (some banks weren’t supported, while others failed to connect). I got my primary checking account setup and several others so I was satisfied. Within a week, the connection to my checking (the most important one by far) was broken. I’ve tried dozens of times to restore it, but it stays offline. Tech support wasted an hour or so of my life before giving up also (supposedly I should be expecting a callback but it been a few days already).

Bottom line don’t pay for any subscription until you’ve verified that your most needed features are actually functional for you. If there’s no free trial period (there was none for me), take a pass on this dud of an app.

Useless. Had reset connection to bank 3 times (with 4 hours between) and it STILL Couldn’t link it to my bank properly MISSING my rent payment, so I made a support appointment. The dude told me to log out. Then I couldn’t log in! Wasn’t receiving emails and it wouldn’t recognize my password. Then he told me I had to call in 4 hours to see if I can find a way to get into my account. He tells me [MARCA] is having issues w them… thats my only bank account so this app is useless. Why would I want to wait 4 hours for updated info? Why isn’t the connection automatic so I know how much money I have and can categorize and spend? Everything is in accurate in my reports. This turned me off to budgeting completely.

Not worth it. It’s honestly not that great and I miss [MARCA] so much. I got a deal on the first year but I will not be continuing. Too many things just don’t function the way I want, and it’s not worth the price tag to me.

Currently not worth it. This app is kind of trash. I’ll give it to stars because at least it doesn’t crash. The web app is better.

On this app:
- I have no way to drill down on reports and look at sub categories.. this is infuriating, what’s the point of having sub categories if I can’t see them in a report? 
- I can’t select/modify multiple transactions at once on the iPad… What’s the point of a big screen if I can’t make use of it?
- the swipe left/right transaction feature is not useful. It feels like they just did it so that they could say “me too” on swipe features.
- it should be easier to pick specific months for reports and it should stay the same as I look at different reports. Right now I have to jump through a whole bunch of hoops to look at my September expenses in different reports.

If this is the way it’s going to be I’m definitely not renewing

Doesn’t stay connected, confusing. It will not connect to my bank (a top 30 bank) or it does and then continues to disconnect so I cannot do my budget. Customer service unhelpful and even when bank was connected, it’s confusing and again customer service wasn’t helpful. There was no way to get a refund or assistance.
couldn’t link to my bank. My bank accounts are with [MARCA] and i was unable to use the app for what i wanted to because i could not link to my bank.  wasted $36

Broken app. Was really excited about using this to budget. App is completely unusable every time I try to login it just immediately refreshes and does not work whatsoever. They of course charged me very quickly.

So many issues linking accounts. When I first began using this application I was [MARCA] happy  with how simple it made tracking my finances. I do not know what changed, but I am now constantly being met with error messages regarding multiple of my linked accounts. 

A quick google search reveals that developers are aware of these issues but can offer no ETA on when they will be resolved. I just cannot justify continuing to pay for a service with known problems in the hopes of them *possibly* being addressed one day. I will consider paying when I have a guarantee of the linked accounts function working once more.
Terrible customer service options. Keyboard doesn’t work to talk to support in their dumb chat that is only open during work hours with no phone number to call

DO NOT GET IF YOU USE BARCLAYS. I purchased a year long membership after a recommendation from a friend who told me this app helped them a lot with their finances. Unfortunately, no matter what I tried, I was unable to connect my [MARCA] credit card account. Without this, the app is essentially useless for me as I make the majority of my purchases with that card. When I called support they told me they were aware of the issue but had no estimation on when it would be fixed, but assured me they were working on it. Months past and every time I’d get the same answer so I finally decided to cancel the membership. I requested a refund as I had paid for it and could not use it, and they told me that refund could only come through [MARCA] and had nothing to do with them. [MARCA] only refunded me about a quarter of what I paid and said there was nothing else they could do. I got completely screwed out of money from an app that was supposed to HELP me with my finances! [MARCA] is a huge institution and it’s absurd they haven’t fixed this issue, they should advertise that so people don’t fall into the same trap I did. Waste of money.
Just Don’t. The Personal and Business software doesn’t work. And I probably wont get a refund through [MARCA].

I would not use it. So I had it for a week. I dog gone and loved everything about it. Set it up categorized about five or six weeks of work. And then I couldn’t get it to upload the daily transactions. When I called for help, they told me to take the bank account off and put it back on. They didn’t tell me it was gonna lose for weeks of that work. Some stayed but then with the bank account started back up. It brought up the newest transactions. It didn’t bring up the other four weeks that it disappeared so at least I could do them over. Not reliable support was horrible. They answered in [LOCAL] , rude, didn’t listen to the issues, and not helpful.

Mint data import is garbage. I was sold on the fact that I could import the mint data I had when they discontinued the old [MARCA] website.  What I did not realize until later, is that the data exported from [MARCA] was total garbage- thousands of duplicate record s with different dates and descriptions so impossible to quickly fix.  Spent hours cleaning up and only a dent fixing this garbage data.

Don’t Use This App!. [APP] developers have destroyed their budgeting tool, “Spending Plan” - now showing all zeros for all months. Support doesn’t exist. Changes to the code s/b tested more thoroughly before deployment so the end users don’t end up with a faulty application - yet they’re still going to keep my money. Go figure.
Going downhill. It was a 4-5 star in 2024. Now my renewal came this month, was paid, and my monthly “spend plan” section is all zeros. They tell me “ It will be fixed, no [MARCA].

Missing transactions, and it happens very often now. The app has a very simple and great interface but keeps dropping/deleting transactions, especially if they are tied to a spending plan… I don’t have the time nor the energy to spend calories with their support team, will move to another platform when the subscription expires… missing transactions = unreliable platform, it really defeats the purpose

Not useful for business. Even though it says it scans receipts, and tracks  mileage it’s useless for business. Don’t waste your money. Then he asked for a refund they deny it. [APP]’s getting terrible.

encountered issues. l with the latest upgrade, my notifications are telling me that my projected balance is lower than it really is. it Took all my reoccurring monthly transactions and put them all weekly, so the projected balance is always negative . very frustrating! please fix it
Spending Plan routinely miscalculated. Kind of a useless app when it can’t even calculate income vs bills correctly. App is incorrect more than it’s correct. Frustrating

30 day refund is a lie. My bank was not supported so I issued a refund. [APP] support says ask [MARCA] then [MARCA] denies the 30 day refund and will not give you your money back while [APP] just says they can’t do anything. Don’t trust this company or [MARCA] refunds. 

This is a total scam! Fraud!

Will take your money even if your bank doesn’t connect. I signed up for [APP] simplifi — they make you click subscribe and pay before you can start setting up your account. So I paid and in the very next screen I learned that my bank doesn’t connect to [APP]. So basically they stole $35 from me. Disgusting.

No Option to test the app. This app prompts you for a year subscription with 0 option to test any features to even confirm it will help what you’re trying to solve. Very poor user experience and has forced me to use [APP] instead.

Only 3 stars because no PDF mobile. I love the program but the mobile does not have upload of PDF files like [APP] Classic. This is a badly needed update. Most receipts sent are PDF and with this day and age you don’t need a computer to do anything. iPads and phone are able to do anything now. [APP] Simplifi makes it so you have to do it by computer. I can’t even do it by using web in browser (which is a pain in the backside) because it opens up the app. Please [APP], fix this and make your application a 5 star application.
Not worth the new price. Sketchy tactics doubling rates right before the first yearly renewal.

Crypto connections are poor. [MARCA] issue unsolved for more than a year.. The app has key functionality working. However, I am personally unhappy that 1. They do not support foreign bank accounts yet (mint did that well) and 2. [MARCA] connection has been broken for a year and they have not been able to fix it. (Their coaches keep blaming [MARCA]). 

If you have a crypto portfolio, it is better to find an alternate choice. [MARCA] doesn’t care about crypto or crypto users.
Dumb and complicated. What a dumb and complicated app it simplifies nothing, I want my money back.

Buggy. I’m new to the app, and while it's fairly user-friendly, there are a few bugs that need addressing. For example, when categorizing a transaction, if you select an account other than "Personal," it automatically categorizes the transaction as "Unassigned." Additionally, if you assign a category, it changes the account back to "Personal," which is quite frustrating. 

I'm considering going back to QuickBooks because it allows you to email a receipt and assign it directly to a transaction or category. In contrast, this app requires several clicks to upload a receipt, making the process slow and cumbersome so far.

Unimpressed. In theory, this app would be great. In practice? It regularly fails to remove pending transactions or recognize recurring expenses. The “low balance alert” would be useful if it didn’t send alerts that my accounts are negative (they’re not). I can’t trust this app to give me any idea of a full financial picture. For the price of the subscription, I’d hope I’d have to do less work to keep it accurate.

Privacy Concerns: [APP] will not delete account upon request. I know this app has solid reviews but from a privacy perspective, after canceling my subscription, I wished to delete my account, so as not to have it live until my subscription ended. There is no option to do this either through the app or desktop. I called and was told it might take about 6 months. (?)  Still holding for a manager…

A Pain. I used this app for 3 months. I felt like I was constantly recategorizing entries. It would also log out of accounts daily so I wouldn’t see all my charges. [LOCAL] charges were doubling up. Wish I could get my money back.
Disappointed in rate change. We signed up for $25 understanding the regular rate would be $50. Just got our new annual charge if $76 (with taxes). Very disappointed.

Pulls in data incorrectly. I used [APP] for years.  This year I switched to [APP] Simplifii thinking it would be easier to have on an app.  But it pulls data in incorrectly- not just assuming categories differently each time, but CHANGING THE PAYEE, so you can’t tell where your money is going or coming from.  When I contacted support they said I could submit screenshots of the two examples I had, but until I had more examples they couldn’t enter a ticket into their system to be looked at.  Why would I continue to use a software with bad data?  Moving on to somewhere else.

Such a downgrade from [MARCA]. This app advertised itself as a replacement for [MARCA] but it’s absolutely not. There’s consistently connection problems and still no connection to Alight which [MARCA] had. The interface is clunky and good luck fixing your accounts if you accidentally closed them. They cannot be reopened which means if you try to re-add an account? Duplicates everywhere.

Not the same level as original [MARCA] app. Ever since we lost the mint app, I have been looking for an alternative. 
For the last year I have been using the Copilot app. It is visually great and navigation is slick but there is certain functionality that it does not have. I tried it for year and came to this app on the recommendation of [MARCA] but I must say it has been a disappointment so far. 
It seems [APP] lost its [MARCA] developers and a different team tried to recreate it without much success. How can a paid app be worst that the free one. 
Navigation is cumbersome. You have to constantly scroll up and down to get to the information you need. There is no single birds-eye view of everything. 
The main widget in the dashboard just shows amount left to spend. What category, it does not say. So you cannot tell which category you need to scale back in. 
Creating a budget is not straight forward and it separates the fixed recurring bills from all others. Fixed amount subscription items and mortgage etc can be put into recurring expenses but I keep groceries and fuel and other non fixed items in the spending plan. The app never shows all of them in one place. It tells me how much I have remaining after fixed recurring expenses but that number is useless unless you don’t plan to buy groceries or fuel or anything else. 
Categorization rules work but the process is not very intuitive and you jump through several screens. 
Plus excluding certain income is a pain. I like to keep a percentage of my income out of the budget but the app does not seem to allow that. Rules also do not take into account the amounts which limit their functionality. 
Charting in the app a not great. A couple of pie charts try to recreate [MARCA]’s charts but they are flat and not interactive. There is no monthly cumulative expenditure trend chart either. 
Honestly, looking at the paid options out there I would have happily paid for [MARCA]. 
I will be weary of any app that doesn’t provide trial period. Now I am stuck with this for a year.
Technical Issues. This app isn’t very compatible with [MARCA] for some reason. Too irritating to try and figure out — requested a refund instead.

Won’t connect to 2FA accounts. I’ve repeatedly tried to get this app to connect to my bank accounts that require 2-factor authentication. The app tries to connect, then errors out an FDP-185 error every time. I’ve tried all their help suggestions to fix the accounts. Nothing works. This makes the entire point of the app useless.
No trial. I am not paying for anything until I try it out first.  Too many other options in budgeting apps.  No free trial sorry but you are not getting my money.
Target card won't update. It's been almost two months and my target card is still not updating in the app. They have no answers and since I bought through apple the can't refund me.
no free trial?. so you’re asking me to pay almost 40 dollars without even a way to try the product first? unbelievable…

Useless app for my needs.. 1.  Bad that they force you into purchase year subscription with no trial, to see if this app is right for you.   2.  [MARCA] won’t refund me and I installed, even though canceled subscription same day.  3.  They won’t delete your user ID with an active account, which will stay that way for a year even though I canceled subscription.  Be sure this is what you want or you will be out money, as [MARCA] isn refusing refund and [APP] is unhelpful.
Awful. Confusing for regular user. Needs a lot of manual adjustments. Web site doesn’t work lol. Waste of money and time

Doesn’t work with [MARCA] credit cards. I bought this app to track my spending in different categories. Unfortunately it doesn’t download transactions from my [MARCA] credit card, which I use for 95% of my spending so the app is useless for me. 

And on top of that [MARCA] won’t give me a refund even though I cancelled my subscription within 24 hours of buying it.

Waste of money / accounts won’t link. They appear to be in some sort of dispute about data sharing with a number of the large financial platforms (ex [MARCA], [MARCA], [MARCA], [MARCA] etc) making this largely useless as my accounts won’t connect. Pretty frustrating and feel like I was lied to about capabilities
Not worth the time or cost.. Too cumbersome to setup and use.  No real benefits and is extremely limited .  Back to excel.

Balance is not correct. I used this app religiously, and I just paid for another years membership and the balance hasn’t been correct since then. I have reconnected my bank multiple times. It’s really getting ridiculous.
Poor and unreliable. App is very poor and unreliable requiring connectivity fixes routinely.

Only a side scrolling advertisement screen. I’ve used this on the iphone for a while. I uninstalled it for security reasons when I went out of the country for a day. Now that I’ve reinstalled it all I get is a side scrolling advertisement screen. I’ve uninstalled reinstalled it with no luck. What the heck.

Don’t. Just don’t. I have never been so frustrated by an app in my life. Unable to add past income, so I’m thousands of dollars over budget on day one. Unable to create a spending plan as all items are in “other spending“ and cannot be easily recategorized. I found the Net Worth being front and center and unable to be hidden very annoying. The app is glitchy, repeatedly gave “error, try again later”and I wasted the better part of a day trying to get it to work. I expected so much more from [APP]. Please do not waste your time or money.
iPad. Does not work on an iPad. You can’t get past the enter passcode screen.

Banks that don’t connect. I found an issue with their connection to [MARCA] bank 3 months ago. Got a notification that it’s a known issue, but still no updates. Don’t purchase if you’re not 100% sure your bank can connect.

Not Functional. Signed up for [APP] simplifi on my desktop and wanted to check out the mobile app. It won’t even show me a sign up page. Zero functionality.

Reached out to [APP] about this and received and figured out what the problem is. The app is badly designed. It had no ability to resize text and it doesn’t work on shorter IPhones like the SE. If you have an IPhone SE don’t bother downloading because you won’t be able to login or see the whole screen.

I really hope the developers rectify the sloppiness of the app. All customers should be able to use it.

Poor Quality. I’ve spent so much time trying to organize my own transactions and income. It doesn’t recognize my income as income. I could have made own spreadsheet with how much time I’ve spent trying to make it work.
It’s ok. I wanted something to track expenses. It works. There are a lot of features that seem overdone and too complicated.

About this tool…. Powerful financial management tool with strong features to track and understand where you dollars are going.  There are some quirky things that happen with some regularity. 1.  Recently, [APP] duplicated many transactions across various accounts and  categories - This really messes financial tracking up.  Support opened a ticket but said they needed more current data than I provided. 2. consistent assignment of regular transactions to the wrong category.  3.  Randomly moves accounts into “Bills” rather than planned spending.  There are others but you get the idea - Need to tie off on loose ends like this.  Doubt that I am the only one seeing this type of behavior.

Horrible attempts to lock you in if you decide it’s not worth it.. My subscription just expired and I don’t want to renew. Guess I’ll just export my data and delete my account and… NOPE. They lock you out (without deleting your data which remains on their servers) if you don’t pay again for another year.

[MARCA] still waiting for the ability to export investment history which has been “coming soon” with a grayed out button since I subscribed a few years ago. I figured it would be simple to leave since they were building this but turns out it was a lie to lock in customers.

Banks don’t link. SCAME!!! BEWARE!! My bank hasn’t linked for months and they continue to say they are working on it. Of course it stopped working AFTER I paid. I contacted support and they say there is nothing to do with this app is A SCAM! Doesn’t work once you pay and they will come up with every excuse to not make it right. Zero money back or anything and it’s been 3 months since I’ve been able to even use the app.

Not worth the trouble. I’m not keen on leaving negative reviews but this one earned it. First off, there’s no trial period. Ok fine. I got over that and paid up. Then it identified recurring transactions based on 3-5 transactions which happened 12-24 months ago and happily assumed I would suddenly start paying these again. But it failed to see recurring income transactions. 
Maybe I’m an “edge case” where my financial situation does actually change often but this is a far cry from the mature product I thought this was going to be. 
It also connected to but ignored a mortgage account. Hullo?
Last but not least, it identified credit card payments as irregular income even though it had access to the bank account sending the payments.  
It’s half baked.  That’s why they’re not giving a trial period. 
So: not worth it.
New to Simplify. I’m having trouble getting the big picture. Some basic instructions would help.

Buyer Beware: [MARCA] Fails at Core Function. I came to [MARCA] as a paid alternative to [MARCA], but it’s been a major disappointment. The app cannot connect to my retirement accounts at [MARCA], so my net worth view is incomplete and essentially useless.

Even worse, my [MARCA] savings account — which is still open and active — has shown the same incorrect balance for over five years. [MARCA] says the account is “up to date,” yet it displays a phantom –$168k balance with no transactions, despite the account actually having a positive balance of just a few hundred dollars.

Between the missing retirement accounts and the broken [MARCA] feed, [MARCA] provides no reliable picture of my finances. It’s nowhere near what [MARCA] offered, and charging an annual fee for this level of inaccuracy feels like a ripoff. Buyer beware.
Not a learning software. I have to keep correcting the same entry every month. It will not connect to [MARCA] accounts.

Bank linking is terrible. I have used this app for over a year. It seems like the bank links work, but I noticed that my balances were reflecting incorrectly in the app. I decided to address it, and was recommended to relink my bank accounts. After 9 months of reviewing and categorizing my transactions, they were all deleted and reuploaded with the wrong categories. So unless I go through and categorize every single transaction, my budgeting history is completely and totally gone. Don’t bother paying for this
Meh - just ok. No ability to save and automate reports, filtering kind of stinks, some of their out of the box category tagging is way off. They are really behind the ball with this product.

Review of [MARCA]. I had used [MARCA] for many years and transferred to [MARCA] after [MARCA] shut down.I have tried very hard with this new platform, but I am sorry to say it is very difficult to use compared to [MARCA]. [MARCA] was so intuitive and gave me exactly what I needed. [MARCA] is much more clunky and constantly characterizes items and also leaves a long list of items which are uncategorized at all. When you try to go out of a report section on spending, the program hangs and you need to go back to home.

I am presently looking at other platforms.
No [MARCA] integration.. [APP] stopped synchronizing with [MARCA] in January 2025 due to systems changes and still no solution so incomplete financial app.

Three MONTHS troubleshooting and won't link my bank!. Getting a constant error when I try to link my bank. [APP] says it's my [MARCA] issue, and my [MARCA] says it is [APP].

Paid for the subscription and has been unusable since day one...

I'll update this review if they ever fix it. Until then, hoping for my money back.
